flight_ready_scope: Simulation commissioning only, using the documented approximate propulsion model; not physical aircraft flight approval or calibrated real-flight performance.
purpose: Hardware evidence and explicit simulation assumptions for X650 commissioning; runnable parameters are in flight_profile.yaml and the 4999 airframe. One server PX4/Gazebo no-arm hover completed on 2026-10-17.

source.mass_provenance: Original CAD totals 3.02 kg; user independently confirmed no-arm all-up mass 3.02 kg for this simulation on 2026-10-17. Not independently weighed by the agent; do not add battery mass again.

known_model.root_flu_definition: +X assumed forward, +Y left, +Z up; physical forward direction still requires confirmation.
known_model.hover_thrust_note: 3.02 * 9.80665 / 4; equal-share approximation before small COM trim, using the user-confirmed all-up mass.

rotor_inertial_model_review.finding: Every 0.18 kg movable link includes a propeller mesh and a complete-looking motor mesh approximately 44.4 mm wide by 42.9 mm high. CAD does not distinguish the fixed stator from the spinning bell/propeller. Do not assume the full 0.18 kg physically rotates.
rotor_inertial_model_review.required_resolution: Confirm the CAD grouping and real rotating mass/inertia, or explicitly document an approximate simulation-only inertial model. Preserve total vehicle mass and COM when splitting fixed and rotating parts.
rotor_inertial_model_review.resolution: prepare_x650_flight.py uses 21g balanced axisymmetric propeller equivalents; fixes motor visuals and redistributes the remaining mass/inertia to base, preserving total mass, COM and zero-angle inertia. Bell inertia remains uncalibrated.

source_joint_limits.status: CAD placeholders, not verified propulsion limits
source_joint_limits.required_resolution: Create an auditable derived rotor model with continuous rotation and a justified speed limit. Do not hide the 5 rad/s limit by choosing an artificial slowdown factor.
source_joint_limits.resolution: Derived continuous joints, physical speed ceiling 628.3185307179587rad/s and numerical slowdown 10. Original CAD retained unmodified.

known_model.scope: Original CAD properties before the documented fixed-motor / rotating-propeller redistribution.

propeller.mass_source: Official P15*5 reference 21 +/-1.5g; not an installed propeller measurement

vehicle.motor_mapping_status: User authorized establishing simulation numbering; physical wiring unverified
vehicle.mass_interpretation: Use supplied 3.02 kg as complete no-arm assembly; battery capacity does not add a second mass term.

bench_data.preferred_coverage: Several points below, near and above approximately 755 gf per motor, plus the highest allowed continuous operating point. State original units if thrust is reported in gf or kgf.
bench_data.optional_dynamic_data: Command-step versus measured RPM or thrust, with sample times, for acceleration/deceleration response.

derived_configuration.provenance: See propulsion_fit.json and flight_profile.yaml; dynamics are Gazebo8 reference estimates, motor thrust is fitted from user-selected manufacturer table
derivation_notes: Angular speed omega = RPM * 2*pi/60. Fit thrust T = kT * omega^2 from matching motor/propeller/voltage data.
Gazebo motor_constant = kT. Gazebo moment_constant = shaft aerodynamic torque Q / thrust T, in metres, not Q/omega^2.
Motor KV times voltage is an unloaded reference, not the maximum loaded rotor speed with the installed propeller.
Electrical voltage times current is not mechanical shaft power; it cannot determine Q without measured efficiency or torque.
PX4 rotor positions use FRD about the whole-vehicle COM: [x-cx, -(y-cy), -(z-cz)]. Gazebo rotor links remain in model FLU.
PX4 motor numbering shown to users is one-based; Gazebo actuator message indices and this platform's motor_number are zero-based.

Dynamic constants and drag coefficients may use explicit preliminary estimates for a labeled commissioning run; do not present such a run as a calibrated hardware performance result. Rotor mapping and maximum thrust must remain consistent and traceable.

preparation_status: Native Gazebo binding, PX4 airframe installation, runtime parameter readback and one no-arm hover/normal landing all completed on the server. Existing server PX4 build reused; no rebuild or dependency download. See simulation_validation for the exact run and remaining approximation scope.
